comments.author: Priya Sharma
comments.body: Need clarity on whether estimate should use story points conversion or the numeric estimate field—will park until analytics weighs in.

content.text: Need clarity on whether estimate should use story points conversion or the numeric estimate field—will park until analytics weighs in.

The velocity chart currently plots completed points per sprint only. Planning leads also want estimated cycle time (from the sprint commitment snapshot) drawn against actual median cycle time for finished cards.

Extend the dashboard velocity series with two optional lines: estimate_hours from the sprint planning freeze, and actual_cycle_hours computed as entered_done_at − first_in_progress_at. Toggle in widget settings defaults to on for new widgets, off for existing ones to avoid surprising layout shifts.
Ship criteria: tooltips show both values for a sprint column, empty sprints omit the actual line, and the export CSV gains estimate_cycle_h and actual_cycle_h columns.
